notes.title: King of Bali Release Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for your continued support of our game and its release. We really hope you all had a laugh and enjoyed our game.

We have made some improvements to some of the translations and interfaces of Chinese and Russian language versions which turned out to not be correct. Also we have fixed some early bugs with achievements.

We are still awaiting approval from Steam to release trading cards and will be adding a CG Gallery very shortly. Keep watching out for it. 

Please continue to provide feedback.

Bang!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29700106/2096b6e52a9c26f21361a1ad43f8d4386f2cfab9.jpg
